title: Close the five GitHub Dependabot alerts on zip by taking candle 0.11.1 from crates.io
goal: GitHub flags five advisories (one critical: GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj) against zip 8.6.0, pulled in only by candle-core, which the workspace patches to a candle git revision from 2026-09-21 because crates.io candle-core 0.11.0 wanted tokenizers 0.22. candle-core 0.11.1 on crates.io requires tokenizers ^0.23.1 and zip ^9.1.3, so the reason for the patch is gone: the five candle [patch.crates-io] entries go, susi-vendor-candle asks for 0.11.1, Cargo.lock resolves zip to 9.2.0 (>= 9.0.5, the fix for every alert) and deny.toml drops its three zip ignores. A test in tests/architecture_tests.rs pins the lockfile: zip at or above 9.0.5 and the candle crates from the registry.
